target_customer.name: Technically supported US direct-to-consumer apparel merchant
target_customer.profile: An apparel merchant or its implementation agency selling one-time physical goods, with a verified customer portal and authority over payment and fulfillment integrations. This is a named target profile, not a claimed customer.

owners.responsibility: Approve or decline scope and appoint implementation/review owners. No human approval is recorded by the worker.

conditions.description: Verify tenant/store/customer ownership; no order enumeration.
Use published versioned policy and current item/order facts.
Retain native references, stable operation identity and unknown-outcome reconciliation.
Qualify the exact payment gateway, API version, account and currency before money-moving use.
Prove every connected fulfillment writer honors holds and final edits before permitting an edit.
Do not release the owned fulfillment hold until required payment and native order state reconcile.
Qualify reservation, source stock and replacement lineage without overselling.
Qualify the actual credit instrument; a local balance is not issued credit.
Qualify the configured carrier/service/account and native label effects.
Record actual receipt, inspection and disposition separately from carrier delivery.
Require the policy-bound human authorization at the declared action boundary.
Qualify mandate, authorization expiry and limited capture; otherwise instant exchange is disabled.
Qualify channel identity, takeover, consent and queued-send suppression.
Publish native/composed/manual differences and verify the connected platform version.
Qualify original allocations, estimates/final fees and currency-specific rounding.

boundaries.rule: Models and independently implemented runtimes are replaceable clients. No provider thread owns business state; no mandatory model provider.
One base skill plus validated platform and merchant profiles. Profiles cannot grant permission or certify unavailable capabilities.
Every released deterministic action has an operator path when model services are disabled.
Scope labels describe intended support only. Actual product, provider, privacy, installation and pilot qualification are required before release.
No warehouses, insurance/coverage, customs guarantees, identity network, health-payment eligibility or paid service is supplied by a skill.
No public distribution or release approval follows from this charter; licensing remains its own decision.
